title: Paths generated by a query node
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha$ be a type of output labels, and let a binary decision tree query a coordinate belonging to its available set, with two child trees indexed by the remaining available coordinates. The paths generated by the tree are the paths from the zero child with value $0$ specified at the queried coordinate, followed by the paths from the one child with value $1$ specified there.
hypotheses_covered: The queried coordinate belongs to the available set
Both child trees are indexed by the available set with the queried coordinate removed
